items.title: 11.2—11.8｜本周精选 AI 论文
items.summary: 本周精选的10项前沿研究，覆盖上下文压缩、技能路由、递归自学习、持续记忆、合规门控、销售智能体、后训练训练场、决策模型、协作基准、生活化任务评测。各项方案都附带实测数据与落地价值，不管是优化成本、提升智能体稳定性，还是搭建自进化系统，都能找到可参考的技术思路。

items.title_zh: 11.2—11.8｜本周精选 AI 论文
items.title_bilingual: 11.2—11.8｜本周精选 AI 论文
items.recommend_reason_zh: NVIDIA 研究者测试了智能体上下文压缩策略：每步只保留简短状态摘要时，Claude Opus 4.5 在 SWE-bench Verified 上得 70.2 分（全历史为 70.0），峰值上下文中位数从 32K 降至 8K token，最佳会话结束压缩设置更能提至 74.8。

en.title: 11.2–11.8 | This Week's Top AI Papers
en.summary: This week's 10 selected frontier studies span context compression, skill routing, recursive self-learning, persistent memory, compliance gating, sales agents, post-training gyms, decision models, collaboration benchmarks, and everyday-task evaluation. Each comes with measured results and practical takeaways—whether you're optimizing costs, improving agent stability, or building self-evolving systems, there's a technical approach worth borrowing.
en.reason: NVIDIA found Claude Opus 4.5 scored 70.2 on SWE-bench Verified with brief per-step state summaries versus 70.0 using full history, cutting median peak context from 32K to 8K tokens—one of 10 papers also covering skill routing and persistent memory.

items.title: Figma 产品经理的 AI 工作流：31 个skills、2 个agent、1 个 Jev
items.summary: 产品经理总会被各种消息、会议和上线琐事追着跑，那么到底可以让AI接住多少活呢？Figma 的增长产品经理 Ezra 拆解了内部落地的 PM OS 工具集，包含 31 个适配产品岗的 Skill，可自主挖掘流失、闭环上线实验的Agent，还有低延迟 Jev 写作助手。如果你也想把 AI 从个人助手带进真实的团队流程里，这篇值得看看。

en.title: A Figma product manager's AI workflow: 31 skills, 2 agents, 1 Jev
en.summary: Product managers are constantly chased by messages, meetings, and launch busywork—so how much of it can AI actually take on? Figma growth PM Ezra breaks down the PM OS toolset deployed internally, including 31 Skills tailored to product roles, an Agent that can autonomously surface churn and run launch experiments end to end, and a low-latency Jev writing assistant. If you want to bring AI from a personal assistant into real team workflows, this one's worth a read.
en.reason: Figma growth PM Ezra Mechaber breaks down a 31-skill PM OS, two agents that surface churn and close launch-experiment loops, and a low-latency Jev writing assistant, with AutoXP letting engineers run five experiments at once.

items.summary: 官方发布了一份Grok Bot创作者终极指南：先让 Bot 学习你的作品和风格，再用它拆解灵感、修改脚本；上传素材后，由你确认剪辑方案，它再制作视频、跨平台发布，并根据观众反馈改进下一条。一起来看看如何在整个流程的每一步都把它配置到位！

en.title: Grok Bot Creator Ultimate Guide
en.summary: An official ultimate guide to Grok Bot for creators has been released: first have the Bot learn your work and style, then use it to break down inspiration and revise scripts. After you upload your assets, you approve the editing plan, and it produces the video, publishes across platforms, and uses audience feedback to improve the next one. Here's how to configure it at every step of the workflow.
en.reason: Grok Bot’s official creator guide shows how it learns a creator’s style, turns voice-fed context into a second creative brain, and handles days of ideation, editing and publishing behind a 60-second video, with dozens of creators already using it.

en.title: More Agents Than Ever — So Why Are Enterprises Still Not AI Native?
en.summary:
Tools solve the parts; the bottleneck lands on value

Tools solve the parts; the bottleneck lands on value

Word count: 15,257. Reading time: about 50 minutes.

AI code-generation rates are soaring, yet end-to-end delivery hasn't gotten faster. General-purpose agents are boosting office productivity, yet overall business performance hasn't risen in step. As enterprises push AI tools into business workflows, the "faster in parts, not faster overall" phenomenon is worth examining. Jiang Linquan, Vice President and CIO of Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group, looked back on three years of AI practice, found answers in the problems, and came away with a clear view of AI Native.

AI Native has become a buzzword enterprises reach for when discussing AI transformation.

Around AI Native sits a long string of concepts — AI code-generation rate, Token Maxxing, coding agents, general-purpose agents, one-person companies, 10x efficiency, fully automated programming, digital employees, Agentic Workflow.

Use a word too often and it seems to "rot": its meaning thins out, everyone says it, no one can quite explain it. That is Jiang Linquan's warning about concept inflation.

His questions: Does using more Tokens make you more AI Native? Does adopting Vibe Coding make a product and R&D organization AI Native? Does using general-purpose agents make a business team AI Native?

en.title: More Agents Than Ever — So Why Are Enterprises Still Not AI Native?
en.summary:
Tools solve the parts; the bottleneck lands on value

Tools solve the parts; the bottleneck lands on value

Word count: 15,257. Reading time: about 50 minutes.

AI code-generation rates are soaring, yet end-to-end delivery hasn't gotten faster. General-purpose agents are boosting office productivity, yet overall business performance hasn't risen in step. As enterprises push AI tools into business workflows, the "faster in parts, not faster overall" phenomenon is worth examining. Jiang Linquan, Vice President and CIO of Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group, looked back on three years of AI practice, found answers in the problems, and came away with a clear view of AI Native.

AI Native has become a buzzword enterprises reach for when discussing AI transformation.

Around AI Native sits a long string of concepts — AI code-generation rate, Token Maxxing, coding agents, general-purpose agents, one-person companies, 10x efficiency, fully automated programming, digital employees, Agentic Workflow.

Use a word too often and it seems to "rot": its meaning thins out, everyone says it, no one can quite explain it. That is Jiang Linquan's warning about concept inflation.
